label: pilot-exchange-mind-map-of-the-enterprise
purpose: The one exchange the Investment Review Board's bounded-pilot allocation permits (decision record: lib/emsenn/content/decision-records/fund-standing-up-notebooklm-as-a-micro-enterprise.json). It settles two questions at once: whether the notebooklm-py client can honestly hold the artifact-or-refusal contract, and what one distillation costs, so the cost-savings claim gets a number for the chief-financial-officer's books.

sources.what-it-is: The enterprise's standing block: the roster of offices, the obligation loop, the delegation rule, the membrane rule, and the class/instance distinction.

prompt: Produce a mind map of this enterprise's structure. Root: the enterprise at lib/emsenn/lib/management. First-level branches: the dispatcher session, the obligation loop, the enterprise membrane, the delegation rule, and the office roster. Under the roster, group the offices by what they check or keep (verdict offices, register-keeping offices, requirements-line offices, delivery offices). Keep every office name exactly as written in the source.

output-contract.success: One exchange record seated in lib/emsenn/services/notebooklm/content/exchanges/ with outcome "artifact", a payload validating against the seated mind-map class via lib/emsenn/lib/management/skills/read-a-schema.js, and a cost block (tokens or wall-time and denomination).
output-contract.failure: One exchange record seated in the same pool with outcome "refusal", carrying stated grounds and the unmet conditions — never a hang, never an absent record once the exchange was attempted.
output-contract.settles-by: sh -c 'latest=$(ls -t lib/emsenn/services/notebooklm/content/exchanges/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -n "$latest" ] && case $(jq -r .outcome "$latest") in artifact|refusal) exit 0 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac'

lane: Executed by requirements-implementation-team through the unit's own run-one-exchange harness, which enforces the one-exchange allocation guard itself. The worker never attests the result; product-quality-assurance witnesses via make-a-task.js --verify pilot-the-notebooklm-micro-enterprise. No pool outside lib/emsenn/services/notebooklm/content/ is written.
authorization: IRB allocation binds exactly one exchange; a second requires the board to re-judge on this one's evidence.
credentials: Google auth material supplied by emsenn at run time (cookie import or master token); never seated in any record, never printed by the harness.
